与购物一起成长(Growing up with shopping): 一篇关于购物消费的B1记叙文:大卫的经历、感受与成长。

David thanked Owen for the honest advice. The online shop has become an important part of daily life. David believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. What's more, puff sleeves demand a neat hem.
There are always more possibilities than we expect. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. David wrote down every idea in a small notebook. The bread has a rustic, open crumb.

The cashier looked quieter than usual that evening. Owen always says that small steps matter more than big plans. David's dream job is to be a doctor. We stopped at a servo outside Melbourne to refuel.
Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. At first, David found it difficult to keep the habit. In fact, the asking price dropped twice.
On Friday evenings, David reviews the notes from class. Owen and David are preparing a report about the cashier. David will take part in a volleyball match in September.
